choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: And when you know, will you tell me?
I shall not go to the Chamber, but I have something better to offer my readers than a speech of M. Danglars.
Panting with loss of breath, he returned to the room he had just left.

title: Barrois — a servant counts the funerals
